def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The color key is the repeated horizontal band at the bottom.
    candidates = []
    for r in range(h-2):
        if grid[r] == grid[r+1] == grid[r+2] and sum(v != 0 for v in grid[r]) > 1:
            candidates = [v for v in grid[r] if v != 0]
    colors = candidates
    keyrow = next(r for r in range(h-2) if grid[r] == grid[r+1] == grid[r+2] and sum(v != 0 for v in grid[r]) > 1)
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(keyrow) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in pts), max(r for r,c in pts)
    shape = [(r-r0, c) for r,c in pts]
    sh = r1-r0+1
    top = r0 - colors.index(1)*sh
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i,color in enumerate(colors):
        for dr,c in shape:
            out[top+i*sh+dr][c] = color
    return out
